title: Lets Talk About What's Going On In The Game Industry And AI
description:
It's been crazy out there. Layoffs, Steam ripoffs, PlayStation and Nintendo jailbroken, and Epic going all in on AI. Let's talk about all of it, what it means for me, and what's next for the channel.
